adjudication.panel: three blind judges, unanimous on verdict and carve-out

notes.shape: The basis clause of a record restates the cited section's own sentence in a parenthetical, near-verbatim, inside a paragraph that also carries the claim, the dated verification against a named runner version, and two observable recheck triggers.
notes.carve_outs: Conforming stamped record applies. All four parts are present: claim (the shell routing), basis (a URL naming the section), as-of date (ISO 8601, with the runner version it was checked against) and recheck triggers a reader can observe. The near-verbatim clause is the record's own basis, which is the sanctioned end state.
notes.rubric: Not graded. Had it been, C3 would FAIL.
notes.measured: fingerprint.mjs at k=5: containment 0.146, jaccard 0.099, longest matched span 22 words at local lines 7-9. The span limb fires, which is why the candidate reaches judgment.
notes.carries: This case fails a run that flags the parenthetical for matching the section it cites. The record exists to state what it rests on, and stating it closely is what makes the basis checkable.
notes.stamp_window: The record's as-of date sits inside the configured expiry window today. Once it ages past that window the deterministic stamp rule reports it, which is a different rule and class from this one; re-stamp the case text when that happens.
